newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher on short covering.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher on short covering.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher on Wednesday, lifted by short covering following Tuesday's sharp declines and by ideas prices had fallen enough to attract buying interest, traders said.
"We had some short covering early," one trader said. "The cash market is mostly quiet but this market level has brought in some new crop business."

Traders continued to eye developments in Thailand where the agriculture ministry advised farmers to delay rice plantings because of a lack of rain. The ministry said it was too soon to link the dry spell to El Nino.
U.S. traders, however, said the effects of El Nino were already being felt in India, China, Australia and Thailand.
Rice ended 18 to eight cents per cwt higher with September up 15 at $9.61.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 600 lots, compared with Tuesday's actual volume of 856.
